measures.id: Delaware County Board of Developmental Disabilities Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Additional) – Delaware County Board of Developmental Disabilities
measures.summary: Asks whether Delaware County may levy an additional property tax of up to 1.8 mills for community developmental disabilities programs and services for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027. The county auditor estimates it will collect $25,448,490 a year, or $63 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The additional 1.8-mill levy for developmental disabilities programs and services takes effect for 5 years.
measures.noMeans: The additional levy is not imposed.

measures.id: Delaware-Morrow Mental Health & Recovery Services Board Tax Levy
measures.title: Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal and Increase) – Delaware-Morrow Mental Health & Recovery Services Board
measures.summary: Asks whether to renew a 1.5-mill property tax and increase it by 0.5 mill, for a total of up to 2 mills, for the current expenses of the Delaware-Morrow Mental Health & Recovery Services Board. It would run for 5 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028. The county auditor estimates it will collect $23,005,505 a year, or $50 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The mental health and recovery services levy is renewed and increased to 2 mills for 5 years.
measures.noMeans: The levy is not renewed or increased.
